name: book-epub-project

scripts.preflight:template: npm run check:local-paths && npm run check:translation-coverage && node scripts/run_python.js scripts/check_template_workflow_gate.py --write-report
scripts.check:chapter-controls: npm run check:translation-coverage && node scripts/run_python.js scripts/check_template_workflow_gate.py --chapter-controls-only --write-report
scripts.release:draft: npm run preflight:template && npm run cover:check && npm run reader:check && npm run literary:scan && npm run metrics:init && node scripts/run_python.js scripts/create_release.py --status DRAFT
scripts.release:create: npm run preflight:template && npm run cover:check && npm run reader:check && npm run literary:validate && npm run metrics:validate:actual && npm run review:random-validate:pass && node scripts/run_python.js scripts/create_release.py --status PASS --require-pass
scripts.build:epub: npm run preflight:template && npm run lint:publication && npm run lint:assets && npm run cover:check && node scripts/build_epub.js && npm run build:bilingual && npm run reader:check
scripts.reader:check: node scripts/run_python.js scripts/check_reader_facing_policy.py --write-report && npm run check:bilingual

description: Book-local npm scripts. Shared Node dependencies are installed once under books/node_modules and are resolved by walking up from the project root.
